title: Fix promote-verify Windows CI parity
objective: Fix promote-verify Windows CI parity: .github/workflows/promote-verify.yml still clones envctl directly on Windows, unlike ci.yml/ai-gatekeeper.yml, so master post-promotion Test (windows-latest) can fail on envctl paths with colons. Reuse the manifest-only envctl stub pattern to keep full verification green without downgrading coverage.
acceptance_criteria: promote-verify.yml uses the same Windows-safe manifest-only envctl stub pattern as ci.yml instead of cloning envctl on Windows.
Workflow YAML parses and full local verification commands remain green.
GitHub PR checks and post-promotion required branch checks are green.
